description: A scenario's test names its runner by its file's extension (cargo, vitest, bash, or a configured template), and a project can send every test and gate through a remote command template for the commit concerned, which never falls back to a local run.

specs.description: A test reference names its runner by its extension
specs.given: the refs `tests/a.rs::f`, `console/src/a.test.ts::adds two`, `ci/check.sh` and `ci/check.sh::fast`
specs.when: each is parsed and its runner chosen with no runner configured
specs.then: they are cargo with name `f`, vitest with name `adds two`, bash with no name, and bash with name `fast`; the file is everything before the first `::`

specs.description: A ref with no extension, or a non-shell file with no name, is not a test reference; an unknown extension has no runner
specs.given: the refs `tests/a.ts`, `noext::x`, `::x` and `tests/a.py::t`, with no runner configured
specs.when: each is parsed and its runner chosen
specs.then: the first three do not parse; `tests/a.py::t` parses but `.py` has no runner, and `hexa spec verify` on a scenario bound to it fails, naming `.py` and `test.runners`

specs.description: A vitest scenario runs vitest from the package directory and passes when exactly the named test ran and passed
specs.given: a project whose `web/package.json` sits above `web/src/a.test.ts`, a scenario bound to `web/src/a.test.ts::adds two`, and an `npx` on PATH that reports one passed test named `adds two` in vitest's JSON
specs.when: `hexa spec verify <ADR>` runs
specs.then: the scenario passes, `npx` was run in `web/` with `vitest run src/a.test.ts -t <pattern> --reporter=json`, and verify exits 0

specs.description: A vitest run that matched nothing, matched a skipped test, or ran more than one test is not a pass
specs.given: vitest JSON reports in which no test ran, the named test was skipped, two tests ran, the named test failed, or no JSON is present
specs.when: each is judged for the test named `adds two`
specs.then: they are vacuous, vacuous, ambiguous (2), failed, and unreadable; none is a pass, and `hexa spec verify` on the skipped one exits non-zero saying it ran 0 tests

specs.description: A bash test script passes on exit 0 and receives its argument
specs.given: a scenario bound to `tests/gate.sh::fast`, where the script exits 0 only when its first argument is `fast`
specs.when: `hexa spec verify <ADR>` runs
specs.then: the scenario passes and verify exits 0

specs.description: A bash script that fails, or that reports zero tests from a runner hexa reads, does not pass
specs.given: one script that exits 1, and one that prints `test result: ok. 0 passed; 0 failed` and exits 0
specs.when: each is judged as a bash test
specs.then: the first fails and the second is vacuous; `hexa spec verify` on a scenario bound to the failing script exits non-zero

specs.description: A configured runner runs its template with the file and name quoted, and passes on exactly one counted test
specs.given: `.hexa/project.json` with `test.runners.py` = `bash run-py.sh {file} {name}`, a script that echoes its arguments and prints `test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed`, and a scenario bound to `tests/t.py::a name`
specs.when: `hexa spec verify <ADR>` runs
specs.then: the script received `tests/t.py` and `a name` as two arguments, the scenario passes, and verify exits 0

specs.description: A configured runner's unrecognised or many-test output is not a pass, and a configured runner overrides a built-in one
specs.given: a configured runner whose output is `all good` with exit 0, one whose output counts 2 passed tests, and `test.runners.ts` set to a template
specs.when: the outputs are judged and the runner for `ts` is chosen
specs.then: the first is unreadable and the second ambiguous, neither a pass; the runner for `ts` is the configured template, not vitest

specs.description: A remote template is filled with the full commit and the command as one quoted word
specs.given: the template `bash ci/remote-gate.sh --commit {commit} --no-gate --extra {cmd}`, a 40-hex commit id, and the command `cargo test --test a -- f --exact`
specs.when: the remote command is built
specs.then: it is the template with `{commit}` replaced by the commit id and `{cmd}` by the command single-quoted as one word

specs.description: A template that lacks a placeholder, or a commit that is not a full id, is refused
specs.given: the templates `run {commit}` and `run {cmd}`, and the commit `abc1234`
specs.when: the template is checked and the remote command is built
specs.then: each template is refused naming the missing placeholder, `{cmd}` or `{commit}`, and the short commit is refused as not a full commit id

specs.description: Any command passes through a remote template unchanged
specs.given: any string, including spaces, quotes, `$`, backslashes and newlines
specs.when: it is filled into `printf %s {cmd}` as `{cmd}` and the result run with bash
specs.then: bash prints exactly the original string

specs.description: Every scenario of a commit goes to the remote runner in one run, and its results are the scenarios' results
specs.given: a project with `test.remote` set to a runner script that clones the pushed commit, prints its id, and runs `{cmd}` there; a spec with two scenarios bound to bash scripts that pass; HEAD pushed and the tree clean
specs.when: `hexa spec verify <ADR>` runs
specs.then: both scenarios pass, verify exits 0, the runner was invoked exactly once, and neither script ran in the project's own directory

specs.description: A test that fails on the remote fails the scenario, and nothing falls back to running it here
specs.given: the same project, with one of the scripts exiting 1 at HEAD
specs.when: `hexa spec verify <ADR>` runs
specs.then: that scenario fails, verify exits non-zero, and the script did not run in the project's own directory

specs.description: The batch markers carry each command's exit status and output back to its own test
specs.given: two commands, one printing `one` and exiting 0, one printing `two` and exiting 3, and a nonce
specs.when: the batch script is run with bash and its output split with the same nonce
specs.then: the split gives (passed, output containing `one`) and (failed, output containing `two`), in order

specs.description: An unpushed commit is refused before anything runs
specs.given: a project with `test.remote` set and a HEAD that no remote-tracking ref contains
specs.when: `hexa spec verify <ADR>` runs
specs.then: it exits non-zero naming `git push`, and the runner was never invoked

specs.description: A runner that does not name the commit, or loses a marker, is a runner failure: not a pass and not red
specs.given: a `test.remote` runner that exits 0 without printing the commit id, and a batch output missing its last end marker
specs.when: `hexa spec verify <ADR>` and `hexa spec red <ADR> <commit> --test <S>=<file>` run, and the batch output is split
specs.then: verify exits non-zero reporting a runner failure, red records nothing and leaves the spec unchanged, and the split is refused naming the missing marker

specs.description: A tree whose tracked files differ from HEAD is refused for a remote run
specs.given: a project with `test.remote` set, HEAD pushed, and a tracked file modified in the working tree
specs.when: `hexa spec verify <ADR>` runs
specs.then: it exits non-zero saying the tree differs from HEAD and to commit and push, and the runner was never invoked

specs.description: `--local` runs the tests here even when a remote is set
specs.given: a project with `test.remote` set to a runner that would record any invocation, and a spec whose bash scenario passes
specs.when: `hexa spec verify <ADR> --local` runs
specs.then: the scenario passes, verify exits 0, and the runner was never invoked

specs.description: `hexa do gate` under a remote refuses without `--local`
specs.given: a project with `test.remote` set and a modified file
specs.when: `hexa do gate --files <f> --evidence 'bash ok.sh' -m msg` runs
specs.then: it exits non-zero naming `--local`, commits nothing, and leaves the change in the tree

specs.description: `hexa do gate --local` under a remote gates here and commits
specs.given: a project with `test.remote` set, a modified file, and a script `ok.sh` that exits 0
specs.when: `hexa do gate --local --no-land --files <f> --evidence 'bash ok.sh' -m msg` runs
specs.then: it commits the file and exits 0, and the runner was never invoked

specs.description: The evidence reader counts vitest's summary and its JSON report
specs.given: a vitest run printing `Test Files  1 passed (1)` and `Tests  5 passed (5)`, and a JSON report with `numPassedTests` 4 and `numFailedTests` 0, each exiting 0
specs.when: each is read as the evidence of `npx vitest run`
specs.then: they pass with 5 and 4 tests

specs.description: A vitest run that failed a test or ran none does not pass
specs.given: vitest summaries `Tests  1 failed | 4 passed (5)` and `Tests  3 skipped (3)`, each exiting 0
specs.when: each is read as evidence
specs.then: the first failed and the second vacuous

specs.description: A gate that is exactly one bash script counts as one passed test
specs.given: the commands `bash ci/check.sh`, `sh ci/check.sh --fast` and `./ci/check.sh`, each exiting 0 with output `ok`
specs.when: each is read as gate evidence
specs.then: each is a single script and passes with 1 test

specs.description: A compound command, a failing script, or a script that ran zero tests is not counted as a script pass
specs.given: the command `bash a.sh && echo done` exiting 0 with output `ok`, `bash a.sh` exiting 1, and `bash a.sh` printing `test result: ok. 0 passed; 0 failed` with exit 0
specs.when: each is read as gate evidence
specs.then: the first is not a single script and is unrecognised, the second failed, and the third vacuous

specs.description: Test files outside tests/ are sealable by their name or their kind
specs.given: the paths `tests/a.rs`, `web/src/a.test.ts`, `web/src/a.spec.tsx`, `src/__tests__/x.ts`, `test/x.js` and `ci/check.sh`; and a spec bound to `web/src/a.test.ts::adds two`
specs.when: each path is judged and `hexa spec seal <ADR>` runs
specs.then: every path is a test file, and the seal records `web/src/a.test.ts`

specs.description: A source file is not a test file and is not bound as one
specs.given: the paths `src/lib.ts`, `web/src/app.tsx`, `src/testing.rs` and `contest/x.ts`
specs.when: each path is judged and `hexa spec red <ADR> <commit> --test S1=web/src/app.tsx::x` runs
specs.then: none is a test file, and red refuses saying the file is not a test file, recording nothing

specs.description: A project with a package.json and no Cargo.toml may accept a spec
specs.given: a project with a package.json, no Cargo.toml, and a committed, covering spec
specs.when: `hexa spec accept <ADR> --by a reviewer` runs
specs.then: the acceptance is recorded and it exits 0

specs.description: A project where no test could be bound is still refused, with the old wording and the way to bind another language
specs.given: a project with no Cargo.toml, no package.json and no `test.runners`, and a committed, covering spec
specs.when: `hexa spec accept <ADR> --by a reviewer` runs
specs.then: it exits non-zero naming Cargo.toml, that tests are generated for Rust only, and `hexa spec red` with `--test`, and the spec file is unchanged
